newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank hikes 163-day T-bill rate.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank hikes 163-day T-bill rate.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank on Tuesday raised the interest rate on its 163-day special series Treasury bill rate to 11.750 percent from 11.675.
Traders said the rise in the 163-day T-bill followed the uptick in the 182-day bills in Monday's regular Treasury bill auction to an average of 12.050 percent from 12.009.
"The Central Bank is correcting the yield curve," said a foreign bank dealer, so that the 182-day bill would have a bigger interest premium over the 182-day bill.
